file.description: A path relative to the working tree. phax never checks that it exists.

lines.description: [start, end]: 1-based line numbers, both included, start at least 1 and end at least start. Null for the whole file.

ReportLocation.description: A file and the lines in it. Checked by phax's parser: lines starts at 1 or above and ends at or after its start.

file.description: A path relative to the working tree. phax never checks that it exists.

lines.description: [start, end]: 1-based line numbers, both included, start at least 1 and end at least start. Null for the whole file.

why.description: Why the finding involves this location, in one line.

ReportRelatedLocation.description: Another location the finding involves, and why. Checked by phax's parser: lines starts at 1 or above and ends at or after its start.

summary.description: One line on how to fix the finding or comply with the rule.

read.description: A file, relative to the working tree, that the agent reads and follows. phax never opens it; what kind of file it is belongs to the provider.

$schema.description: The gate-report format and the phax release that wrote this file: https://docs.phax.run/schemas/gate-report/<X.Y.Z>.json

outcome.description: The step ran its checks: findings and review notes follow.

id.description: The provider's own id for the finding, stable across runs of the same check and unique within the report. phax compares it by equality only.

rule.description: The rule the finding breaks, in plain words.

message.description: What was found, in one line.

related.description: The other locations the finding involves, in the provider's order. May be empty.

guide.description: How to fix the finding: a summary and a file to read, or null when the provider gives none.

findings.description: What fails, in the provider's order, which is its rank: each the rule it breaks, where, what was found and how to fix it. Any finding fails the step, whatever its exit code; an empty list passes it on exit 0. Checked by phax's parser: no two findings share an id.

owner.description: Who should look at the note: a person or a team, in the provider's words.

note.description: What a person should look at, in one line.

review.description: Notes for a person, in the provider's order. A note never fails the step and reaches only the reviewer, never the agent. May be empty.

$schema.description: The gate-report format and the phax release that wrote this file: https://docs.phax.run/schemas/gate-report/<X.Y.Z>.json

outcome.description: The step declined to run its checks: the phase stops for the operator, with no fix attempt.

reason.description: Why the step declined to run, in one line.

remedy.description: What the operator does so that the step runs, in one line.
